title: Renovate California Beachfront Home: Planning shows Kutcher, Kunis expand retreat; cottage to go
summary_full: Ashton Kutcher and Mila Kunis are planning a significant renovation of their Carpinteria beachfront property. The proposed changes include expanding the main residence and adding a swimming pool. They acquired the property in 2017 for $10.1 million and have seen its estimated value rise to about $17 million. The couple's plans involve the removal of a guest cottage to enhance the outdoor living space.
